title: Mutex lock().unwrap() in request handlers
description: inbox.rs:610 and webauthn.rs:409,466. Mutex::lock().unwrap() on SEEN_DIGESTS and PASSKEY_TOKENS in code paths reachable from network requests. If any thread panics while holding the lock, the Mutex becomes poisoned and all subsequent requests to these handlers will panic. Should use .lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner()) or let the PoisonError propagate as an AppError.
